metadata.title: Signal Earth Analytical Numbers Ledger
metadata.description: Empirical figures cited across research papers, verified against underlying scripts and data files.

kanpur_particulate.title: Kanpur Particulate Dynamics
kanpur_particulate.finding: Winter PM2.5 averaged 2.40x monsoon levels across both observation windows (61.41 vs 25.61 ug/m3 across 1,628 station-days).
kanpur_particulate.period: July 2021 to October 2022 and February 2025 to August 2026
kanpur_particulate.limitation: 855-day operational monitoring gap between observation windows; spatial coverage restricted to two urban monitors.

delhi_naqi.title: Delhi Five-Year NAQI Dynamics
delhi_naqi.headline_label: Valid days governed by particulate matter
delhi_naqi.finding: Particulate matter governed official AQI on 95.3% of valid days (PM2.5 on 51.8%, PM10 on 43.4%), with a 5.75x peak haze multiplier.
delhi_naqi.period: 2017 to 2023 (1,137 days satisfying CPCB minimum reporting quorum)
delhi_naqi.limitation: 731-day operational hiatus during station refurbishment (2019-2020); single peripheral monitoring station.

kanpur_temperature.title: Kanpur Skin Temperature & Particulate Association
kanpur_temperature.finding: Daily surface skin temperature exhibits a moderate negative seasonal correlation with PM2.5 (r = -0.455 across 308 concurrent pairs).
kanpur_temperature.source: NASA POWER (GMAO MERRA-2 daily skin temperature TS)
kanpur_temperature.limitation: Coarse regional reanalysis grid cell (0.5 deg x 0.625 deg, ~55 x 60 km) cannot resolve intra-urban heat islands.

kanpur_landsat.title: Kanpur Landsat 30 m Thermal Infrared
kanpur_landsat.finding: Landsat 8/9 TIRS-2 radiometric snapshot observed an empirical urban-rural thermal delta of 1.0 to 2.3 K across winter clear-sky overpasses.
kanpur_landsat.source: USGS Landsat 8/9 TIRS-2 Band 10 (30 m resampled)
kanpur_landsat.limitation: Instantaneous clear-sky daytime snapshot observation; requires vertical atmospheric soundings to confirm inversion dynamics.
